title: LibRPA W fails at Gamma because dielectmodel.cpp clears wing_mu after the RPA basis conversion
symptom: Run 1 completes RPA (-0.11826108037212188 Ha, imag 6e-15) and EXX, but W fails with 'W failed Gamma vector at 0 empty': the Gamma wing vector is empty even though the object still reports has_wing=true.
root_cause: src/core/dielectmodel.cpp:3130 executes wing_mu.clear() immediately after the RPA basis conversion, so the retained head/wing object is already consumed; has_wing stays true while the raw mu (wing) data the Wc conversion needs is gone. has_wing is a flag, not a liveness guarantee.
minimal_fix: Re-read the head/wing input freshly (read_headwing_input) immediately before the W/Wc conversion instead of reusing the consumed has_wing=true object; the prototype fix required no core change.
validation: Rerun the same case: the RPA total must stay -0.11826108037212188 Ha with imag ~6e-15, EXX unchanged, and the Gamma wing vector must be non-empty so W completes; keep the added PSD/definiteness checks on the paired head/wing matrices.
avoid: Do not treat has_wing=true as proof the wing data is still alive, and do not work around the empty Gamma vector by loosening tolerances or skipping Gamma.

parameters.has_wing_flag: not a liveness flag; re-read head/wing input before the Wc conversion
